column3: None supplied; private sample explicitly withheld
column4: Initial report describes missing elements and mixed orientation; later file inspection identifies dynamic XFA, one fallback page, and named master breaks, not ordinary PDF page rotation. Missing elements remain unisolated and the proposed XFA root cause is not runtime-proven.
column6: packages/import/src/pdf/index.ts imports static page content; it has no dynamic XFA layout or master-break interpreter. Ordinary publishing pages are not XFA masters.
column7: No claim of upstream reproduction or a fixed mixed-orientation Varve renderer. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3910

column4: The final discussion corrects the radio-group hypothesis: /FT /Btn fields have several widgets with distinct on-state names. Locally inspected PDF objects 1079 (Retired: Yes/No) and 976 (seven Child Relation Status widgets); rendered/read page 5. pdfinfo reports 8 pages, AcroForm, JavaScript, no encryption. No PDF scripts executed.
column6: packages/import/src/pdf/index.ts imports static text/rectangle content, not interactive PDF widget values. No FieldValue::Check or AcroForm save path exists.
column7: No upstream click/form_fill reproduction here; the reported reproduction remains attributed to its author. Do not generalize this to correctness of Varve app checkboxes. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3911

column4: Printer default media is ignored; the only comment points to work in #2551, not proof of a shipped fix.
column6: packages/platform/src/platform.ts and memory.ts/web.ts/tauri.ts declare/implement listPrinters and printPdf; repository package search found no callers. PDF page/export dimensions are a different boundary.
column7: No physical-printer qualification or assertion that upstream #2551 is merged. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3912

column4: Compare retains positional view indices across a callback that can close a tab; both halves and the post-draw scroll read can retarget or index out of bounds. The report is a static finding, not a local runtime reproduction.
column6: No side-by-side PDF snapshot compare/document_area callback loop exists in the editor. Session metadata in packages/editor/src/context.tsx is keyed by session id rather than retained compare indices.
column7: Stable identifiers are a transferable rule, not runtime proof that all Varve close paths are safe. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3915

column4: Two mechanisms: stale annotation positions and page-organizer drags across edits/undo. The last comment proposes #4039 for drag only and explicitly leaves annotations open. The former ledger's no-annotation explanation omitted the page-drag mechanism.
column6: No PDF annotation editor, but packages/editor/src/components/PageNav/PageNav.tsx has live drag reordering. computeReorderedPageIds resolves stable page ids and checks missing ids; its unit test does not exercise pointer release after undo or document replacement.
column7: Inspect #4039 production/regression evidence and run a real pointer/undo/drop workflow before deciding the page-drag transfer. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3916

column4: Failed thread spawn or an escaped panic never populates the result, leaving Export/OCR/Action Wizard progress active. Proposed #4043 covers Export and Action Wizard, explicitly not OCR; its author also discloses untested GUI picker success paths. JS exception or timer handling is not equivalent to these worker failure boundaries.
column6: packages/editor/src/exportService.ts catches JS export failures and stops the batch on unresolved timeout. Existing node-budget tests do not simulate real native worker launch/panic followed by reset/retry.
column7: Partial adjudication: inspect #4043 and the actual Varve provider boundary. Correct the obsolete ledger claim that later jobs continue after timeout. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3919

column4: PDF/A conversion removes Standard Security Handler encryption under modify-only permission. Last comment retracts the proposed-new-fix status and says a fix exists elsewhere, without a concrete PR or commit; no shipped outcome inferred.
column6: packages/import/src/pdf/index.ts encryptedResult rejects encrypted PDFs; packages/import/src/pdfIntegrity.test.ts has an explicit encrypted-input rejection case. Archive AES-GCM is not a PDF owner/user-permission handler, and no ConvertPdfA operation exists.
column7: No claim that PDF permissions are a hard security boundary, no upstream runtime test. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3921

column4: Four separate mechanisms: unguarded MCP resource dispatch, unbounded input lines, fatal invalid UTF-8 and unbounded tool-named file reads. Absence of an MCP server answers only the first three exact paths; it does not establish bounded document ingestion elsewhere.
column6: No MCP server found in the tree. packages/cli/src/cli.ts loadDocumentFile calls readFileSync(path, 'utf8') without a pre-read limit. This is user-invoked local CLI intake, not an agent-facing MCP endpoint, but the resource-exhaustion question was omitted by the old disposition.
column7: Reproduce/measure CLI admission and decide a format-compatible bound or explicit scope before closure; no assertion of a proven exploitable Varve failure. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3924

column4: Password-flag PDF field values reach /V, undo, recovery and incremental saves despite appearance masking. This report has no discussion or attached repro; the code-review scenario is not a runtime result.
column6: No interactive PDF form model or Password-flag save path in packages/import/src/pdf/index.ts. packages/editor/src/archive/encryption.ts deals with container credentials, not authored form-field contents.
column7: Do not count UTF-8 buffer wiping as a fix for persisted form passwords, or assert all secret-bearing Varve inputs are verified. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3926

column4: Eight items, not just CLI/update/OCR: OCR arithmetic, compiled model fallback, URL normalization, truthful removal counts, asynchronous Reopen, duplicate remote-GoTo opens, stale Combine row drag, and redaction/history disclosure. The old outside-scope row omitted applicable workflow classes.
column6: apps/desktop/src/updates/tauriUpdateProvider.ts uses the Tauri updater rather than the reported RELEASES_PAGE-prefix test. Varve nevertheless has a Reopen Last Closed File shortcut and async file intake; sortable/reorder and model-resource paths also require their own applicability check.
column7: Adjudicate every item and reproduce applicable asynchronous reopen/duplicate/drag/count boundaries. No blanket terminal disposition from absent OCR/redaction UI. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3929

column4: Report says Organize > Crop Pages leaves the full-page view while searching Crop keeps it. Inspected screenshot shows the Organize pages sidebar, Crop pages entry and a selected thumbnail, not the transition itself. Final comment promises a PR but supplies no link or shipped result.
column6: Varve's image CropTool edits a selected image/fill on the canvas, not PDF page boxes in an organizer. createActionHandlers.ts toolCrop delegates setTool('crop'); the inspected CropTool path has no thumbnail-overview switch.
column7: Static applicability assessment only; no claim that a screenshot reproduces a sequence or that all Varve crop entry points were runtime-tested. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3936

column4: Requests Tamil OCR. Inspected image shows Recognize Text with English selected, searchable-image output and 300 dpi; the language list is closed, so the image alone does not prove only English is offered. All six rendered PDF pages were inspected and contain Tamil-script scanned material; pdfinfo reports no forms, JavaScript or encryption.
column6: No OCR provider or language-recognition UI in the editor. Editable Tamil artwork rendering/shaping and image-to-path tracing are different capabilities from recognizing Tamil scan text.
column7: No OCR engine was executed or recognition accuracy judged. Full policy translation is unnecessary for this applicability decision and is not claimed. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3937

column3: No source form or screenshots supplied; privacy limitation explicit
column4: Acrobat icon/popup methods are missing and a throwing document initializer prevents custom Calculate/Format/Validate scripts. The discussion proposes #3985 for script-error isolation but explicitly leaves same-run calculateNow and missing methods open; popup support is a separate proposed #2081. Reported arithmetic success is not proof of event dispatch or a shipped fix.
column6: packages/import/src/pdf/index.ts has no Acrobat JavaScript VM, field event dispatcher or /CO calculation engine. Importing static artwork is not running imported document scripts; Varve's extension APIs are not Acrobat's document/field object model.
column7: No upstream reproduction, PR execution or assertion that all Varve extension failures are isolated. Source: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/issues/3940

column6: Current editor UI copy is English; multilingual artwork shaping in docs/architecture/text-pipeline.md is a separate capability from localized application strings. No Korean UI language-pack implementation is part of this transfer review.
